title: Warm Roman Cherry Flatbread
description: A yeasty and snappy Italian flatbread featuring caramelized dried cherries, perfect for a romantic Mediterranean-inspired snack
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine yeast and warm water, stirring to dissolve the yeast.
Add flour, dried cherries, olive oil, salt, and sugar to the bowl, mixing until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead the dough on a floured surface for 5 minutes, until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with plastic wrap, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Preheat a comal or griddle over medium heat, brushing it with a small amount of olive oil.
Punch down the dough and divide it into 4 equal pieces, rolling each into a ball and flattening slightly into disks.
Cook the flatbreads for 2 minutes on each side, until they are golden brown and crispy.
Brush the flatbreads with olive oil and sprinkle with chopped rosemary leaves.
Serve the warm flatbreads immediately, perfect for snacking or as a side dish.
